payload.title: M1 TTAB decisions corpus: full metadata, opinions and text
payload.description: Ingest every TTAB decision from the USPTO TTAB Reading Room API (about 19,000 since 1986): metadata, opinion PDFs on the S3 shelves, extracted text, catalogued in DynamoDB. Dedupe on documentId; handle late precedential designations. Feeds the Rulings tracker, the classifiers and every TTAB analysis.
